uutiset.t: Venezuela’s Machado Urges More Drastic Overhaul of Oil Sector
uutiset.s: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado wants to reshape the country’s energy industry even beyond the dizzying changes it has undergone this year, signaling a more critical role for private industry should she clinch the presidency. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Trump, Xi Agreed on AI Limits in Military Action, Bessent Says
uutiset.s: President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping agreed that artificial intelligence should never be allowed to make autonomous major military actions, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday.
